name: Sunray Aspen 3-Person Indoor Infrared Sauna 300K2
description: Description The SunRay Aspen 3-Person Indoor Infrared Sauna is built from Canadian hemlock for strength and a natural finish. It is equipped with 8 carbon nano-heaters that evenly distribute heat up to 140°F while maintaining low EMF levels. Features include dual digital keypads, movable ergonomic backrests, chromatherapy lighting, a Bluetooth speaker system, an oxygen ionization system, recessed interior and exterior lighting, cup holders, and more.
